title: Chimps plunder less pineapple from friends — and expect them to do the same
summary: UC Berkeley researchers also found that stealing from non-friends caused more agitation, providing a window into how chimpanzee emotions may be similar to our own. The post Chimps plunder less pineapple from friends — and expect them to do the same appeared first on Berkeley News .
author: Jason Pohl
